independent_domain_result.scope: Exact real-rational subcase of supplied complex interface; neither necessity nor derivation of the quantum assumptions.

remaining_obligations: Derive or explicitly continue to admit complex scalar, Hilbert, positive-cone, Born, tensor, channel, time and observer structures.
Selected real-rational examples do not establish all complex-system or dimension-uniform laws.
Missing-slot API checks do not establish logical independence, necessity or uniqueness of quantum mechanics.
The general refined probability/state/effect operad and its symmetry/coherence remain formal obligations.

claim_boundary.supports: Exact finite examples exercising supplied quantum operations, and literal conditional interface normalization/channel theorems.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: Derivation, necessity or independence of the quantum interface from primitive difference, or a derived time/dynamics.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: Three exact rational-real examples on an admitted finite quantum carrier with explicit source and import boundaries.
claim_boundary.next_test: Audit declarations and actual matrices; do not promote API refusal or component counts to theorems.

review_regressions: Ten shared audit regression tests passed normally and under Python -O; each test may exercise all ten tasks.

final_native_integration.scope: Fresh current source tree, distinct from historical per-attempt snapshots. Local exact gates, no whole-repository/hosted-CI claim.

researcher: One local Codex researcher. Independent domain predicates are separate code, not an independent author or panel.
